title: Set passage 2:183-185 annotation
subject: Islamic Studies
unit: Summer 1: Sawm, Zakah and Khums, Hajj (3.3 to 3.5)
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y10 lesson 25 (Pupil PDF worksheet: set passage 2:183-185 annotation)
intro: Read the text carefully. Annotate it: underline key words and write your ideas in the margin.

parts.text: One mark per accurate point: 1) no food, drink or marital relations; 2) from true dawn to sunset; 3) intention each night; 4) the whole month, which begins with the new moon.
Teacher writes point 1: 'Firstly, 2:183 teaches that fasting is prescribed so that Muslims attain taqwa. This means fasting trains a Muslim to obey Allah even when no one is watching.'

questions.q: Describe the nature of fasting in Ramadan. (4 marks, our own question)
questions.a: Abstaining from food, drink and marital relations from true dawn to sunset; with intention; for the whole month of Ramadan; with suhur and iftar.
questions.model: One mark per accurate point: 1) no food, drink or marital relations; 2) from true dawn to sunset; 3) intention each night; 4) the whole month, which begins with the new moon.

questions.q: 2:185 says Ramadan is the month in which ...

Set passage task in the portal response box (6 marks, our own question): 'Explain what Qur'an 2:183-185 teaches about fasting.' Frame: three points, each developed with a quote and an explanation. Start: 'Firstly, 2:183 teaches that ...'
questions.a: Taqwa as the purpose (2:183); concessions for the ill and travellers and fidyah (2:184); Ramadan linked to the Qur'an and Allah's wish for ease (2:185), each explained
